channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Tim Scott Backs Graham Ahead of South Carolina Senate Runoff
item.description: Sen. Tim Scott said on NBC's "Meet the Press" that Sen. Darline Graham is clearly qualified for the Senate, offering his support.

item.title: Karoline Leavitt Announces Next Move After White House Role
item.description: Karoline Leavitt said on Air Force One she will join Trump's super PAC MAGA Inc. after leaving her position as press secretary.

item.title: El-Sayed Faces Backlash Over Posts Targeting Usha Vance and Aide
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed's comments about Usha Vance and JD Vance's grandfather drew accusations of racism and sexism from Rep. Brandon Gill and others.

item.title: NYC Taxpayers May Face Double Costs Under Mamdani Grocery Plan
item.description: Zohran Mamdani's city-owned grocery proposal could lead to double taxpayer costs as NYC considers grants for independent grocers alongside subsidized stores.
